title: Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation (VCAP)
mechanism: Component-size thresholds adapted per case to the predicted lesion burden, fitted cross-fold.
adaptation: Per-cell predicted crack burden sets min component length and peak-probability cut for crack components; fitted on val + F51 or module-grouped CV out-of-fold maps of the existing 5-seed ensemble; no retraining.
min_experiment: Arm: VCAP rule on ensemble maps. Baseline: ensemble with val-chosen logit bias. Metric: test and E1 crack relF1@2 and component F1. Kill: relF1@2 gain < 0.005 and component F1 gain < 0.01.
evidence: ISLES'26 training set 1,453 cases, 5-fold: lesion F1 +0.032 from VCAP, about 6x any architecture change tested; post-processed ensemble Dice 0.651 / lesion F1 0.614 vs 0.644 / 0.573.
prior_overlap: Per-module thresholds and global logit bias were tried; per-component, burden-conditioned rules were not.
